title: Paired lore+quest hardening (OPAG-453): dash-led scope token (F4) and Unicode format characters passing the sanitiser (F5)
description: Routed by opum-agent OPAG-453 (orchestrator 94d64804, 2026-09-26T19:43:37Z), found by quest-cli's reviewer in code byte-identical to lore-cli dc09ca98 (LCLI-592). Ruling (d) keeps the two CLIs byte-identical here: quest-cli PROPOSES the change and lore-cli agrees it; a string or shape both repositories agree binds without the orchestrator. F4: the Claude scope token /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/ accepts a dash-led value, so a scope of '--scope' reaches both the printed remedy and argv. lore-cli has ALREADY tightened this to /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/ in LCLI-593 (opum-ai/lore-cli#297, head 235b3fe0, src/core/agent-plugins.ts; the adversarial review reproduced '--scope --help' through a stub), matching OPAG-453's proposed regex exactly. Only parity confirmation with quest-cli remains. F5: stripAnsiAndControls (src/errors.ts, which strips ANSI plus C0/C1 only) passes Unicode format characters: RLO U+202E, which reorders a printed line, and ZWSP. It must also strip U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E, U+200F, U+061C, U+200B-U+200D, U+2060 and U+FEFF. OPEN SCOPE POINT, for agreement with quest-cli before implementing: in lore, stripAnsiAndControls is the single shared sanitiser (LORE-181) used by 8 source files (check, query, replace, output, validate and links messages among them), not only plugin text. Extending it changes every sanitised output, and stripping U+200D (ZWJ) splits emoji ZWJ sequences in document titles or ids that lore query and check print. Settle with quest-cli whether the shared helper carries the full set, or runtime-sourced text gets it while ZWJ is kept for document text. Record the agreed choice here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: F4: the dash-led scope rejection is on lore-cli dev (via LCLI-593) and confirmed byte-identical in shape to quest-cli's fix, citing both SHAs

F5: the agreed sanitiser strips U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E, U+200F, U+061C, U+200B-U+200D, U+2060 and U+FEFF from runtime-sourced text reaching --plain/pretty output, proven by tests including an RLO that would reorder a printed line; the agreed scope (shared helper vs runtime-only) and its ZWJ consequence are recorded here
The parity is cited: lore-cli's implementing SHA and quest-cli's are exchanged (via opum-agent while quest-cli is being renewed); bun test and bun run lore check exit 0
